locations.note: Cengio: Austro-Hungarian troops storm the summit and Fort Corbin in the Strafexpedition of 1916.
Fior: the second Strafexpedition map, on the Asiago plateau.
Carso: the conquest of Monte San Michele on the Karst in the Sixth Battle of the Isonzo.
Sabotino: the Italian storm of the ridge above Gorizia in the Sixth Battle of the Isonzo.
Gorizia: the last map of the Sixth Battle of the Isonzo, the Italian push into the town in August 1916.
Dolomiti: the Italian capture of Sasso di Sesto below the Torre di Toblin in August 1915.
Piana: the summit plateau fought over for two years, a Mountain War map.
Caporetto: the Austro-German breakthrough of October 1917, fought from Tolmin up to the Kolovrat ridge, which brought the German army into the game.
Piave: the German attack on the Vidor bridgehead on 10 November 1917, through a vineyard and castle ruins into the town and its abbey.
Grappa: the defence of the massif after Caporetto, the third map of the Caporetto expansion.
Marmolada: fighting in the 'Ice City' tunnelled into the glacier, a White War map; also the climb of the Ascent mode.
Adamello: high-altitude fighting on the Presena peak of the Adamello-Presanella Alps.
Montello: the Austro-Hungarian attack of the Solstice offensive in June 1918.
Moschin: a night map of the Austro-Hungarian assault on Col Moschin on 15 June 1918.
